label: Sub-Workflow
description: Executes an embedded workflow definition as a nested sub-step and returns its combined step outputs.

definition.description: An inline workflow definition object ({ steps: [...] } or { nodes: [...], edges: [...] }). Paste a workflow definition exported from the editor.

inputs.description: Optional key-value pairs merged into the first step's config as initial data.

stepOutputs.description: An object containing each sub-step's output keyed by step name.

status.description: Final status of the sub-workflow: 'success' or 'failed'.
